title: I Let the Open-Plan Captions Play All the Way to Legal

parts.text: I heard my name through the partition during a budget that was not a budget. I am thirty-five, reluctant manager, cold coffee skin on the cup. Hal and Sasha talked about moving my projects before an announcement. Mei, junior, went wide-eyed. The HVAC roared like a cover band. Hal's laptop auto-captioned the crime. Hal said, "How long have you been sitting there" I said, "The whole meeting" I photographed the captions because I am IT-adjacent in my soul. I can still name the ugly little detail, which is how I know it happened. I noticed a scuff on the floor shaped like a comma, which fit i. Someone had left a receipt in the cup holder, faded blue ink. The air tasted like leftover rain and cleaning spray, which fit i. A cheap clock on the wall jumped a minute late, then caught up. I kept my keys in my left pocket so I would not fidget, which fit i. The plastic chair stuck to my legs when I shifted. A vending machine hummed in another room like a bored insect, which fit i. I counted three ceiling tiles with water stains before I spoke again. My socks had a hole I had been ignoring since Tuesday, which fit i.
parts.cliffhanger_hint: He is reaching toward my personal phone, and the captions still say restructure.

parts.text: I mailed myself the photo from the hallway they recommended. HR auto-replied with a lottery ticket number. Monday, legal had the Teams file. Hal said hypothetical. Captions do not hypothetically spell Dev. Mei submitted timestamps. They paused the restructure. Sasha offered kitchen small talk like a treaty. I booked rooms for calls after that, even five-minute ones. The mug I bought says nothing on purpose. Legal said, "Is this a hypothetical" Hal said, "We were exploring options" The HVAC still makes me flinch. Buildings are rude that way. parts.text: I declined the bonus and took a written project-protection note. Hal went regional. I later left for a job a recruiter opened after I told the caption story once, dry. Mei got a real mentorship on a calendar. I still hate collab tables. I still love timestamps. Quiet dread was never quiet in an open plan. That is the architecture problem and the ethics problem, holding hands. I drink coffee faster now so it cannot grow a skin. That is the mundane detail I kept. Recruiter said, "Why leave mid-level" I said, "Auto-captions" The new office has doors. I close them without apology. I can still name the ugly little detail, which is how I know it happened.
